name: Analyze data
definition: Query, transform or compute over a dataset to answer a question or produce a result.

name: Browse the web
definition: Navigate websites and interact with web pages to reach a goal.

name: Handle customer support
definition: Answer customer requests and resolve support tickets.

name: Operate a computer
definition: Control a desktop or mobile interface through clicks, typing and application actions.

name: Research a topic
definition: Gather information from several sources and synthesize findings on a question.

name: Review code
definition: Inspect existing code or a code change and report defects or improvements.

name: Write code
definition: Write or modify source code to implement a requested change.

name: Write a document
definition: Draft a report, article or other long-form document.
